AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Protection: Weed control? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Protection: Weed control.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Protection: Weed control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Protection: Weed control.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Protection: Weed control.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock.

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Land Preparation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Land Preparation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Land Preparation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Land Preparation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Land Preparation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

10. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 37 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agricultural Land? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agricultural Land.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agricultural Land.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agricultural Land.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agricultural Land.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Properties of soil? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Properties of soil.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Properties of soil.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Properties of soil.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Properties of soil.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Field Management Practices? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Field Management Practices.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Field Management Practices.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Field Management Practices.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Field Management Practices.

14. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crops 1.6 Crop Protection: Weed control 1.7 General Crop Harves.

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on General Crop Harvesting 2.0 Animal Production 2.1 Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe H.

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safe Handling of Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safe Handling of Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safe Handling of Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safe Handling of Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safe Handling of Animals.

18. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Milk souring
   D. Ice melting to water

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Breeds of Livestock 2.2 Safe Handling of Animals 2.3 General Animal Health 2.4 B.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Selected Crop? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Selected Crop.

   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Selected Crop.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Selected Crop.

21. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

22. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
